hero.role: Backend, cloud and generative AI engineering
hero.title: Backend and AI platforms that reach production and stay maintainable.
hero.lead: I'm David Jonatan Zapeta Chavez. With 8+ years of experience, I design APIs, microservices and automation on AWS and Azure, working side by side with product and business to turn requirements into secure, measurable systems that are easy to evolve.

diagram.title: Reference architecture
diagram.hint: Select a component to see what I solve there.

client.label: Clients
client.text: Interfaces that consume stable, versioned API contracts, so web and mobile evolve without breaking each other.

gateway.label: Access
gateway.text: Delegated identity, role-based access control and rate limits. Security is designed from the first endpoint, not added at the end.

services.label: Services
services.text: Modules built with OOP and SOLID: the domain does not depend on infrastructure, so it is tested in isolation and swapping a provider does not force a rewrite of business logic.

events.label: Events
events.text: Asynchronous processing with idempotent retries, dead-letter queues (DLQ) and circuit breakers so one failure does not cascade.

data.label: Data
data.text: Relational and NoSQL models, optimized queries and indexes, migrations, backups and disaster recovery plans.

ai.label: AI
ai.text: Semantic search over your own knowledge, with guardrails and evaluations that catch out-of-scope answers before they reach the user.

platform.label: Platform
platform.text: Infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines with security gates that block deployments with vulnerabilities.

observability.label: Observability
observability.text: Metrics, traces and alerts to resolve incidents proactively, with signals both the team and the business understand.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Four areas where I can support your team. Pick one to see how I approach it.

items.title: Backend architecture and APIs
items.summary: Services and APIs that are understandable, testable and ready for product growth.
deliver: REST and GraphQL API design with versioned contracts
Modular NestJS or FastAPI services with automated tests
Relational or NoSQL data model and migration strategy
approach: I separate domain, use cases and infrastructure using OOP and SOLID
I define contracts before implementing, together with whoever consumes them
I document architecture decisions so the team can maintain them

items.title: Generative AI and RAG
items.summary: AI features with clear limits, measurable and ready to operate.
deliver: Embedding pipelines and semantic search over vector databases
RAG flows and agents with LangChain or LangGraph
Input and output guardrails, plus quality evaluations
Observability for cost, latency and answer quality
approach: I start from the use case and how success is measured, not from the model
I keep a human in the loop where the risk demands it
I evaluate before release and monitor after, in production

items.title: Cloud, DevOps and platform
items.summary: Reproducible infrastructure and frequent releases without compromising security.
deliver: Infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS or Azure
CI/CD pipelines with static analysis and vulnerability gates
Docker containers and orchestration when the case justifies it
Dashboards and alerts with Grafana, CloudWatch or DataDog
approach: I automate what repeats and keep everything versioned and reviewable
I put security controls inside the pipeline, not after it
I decide which signals matter before instrumenting

items.title: Technical leadership and business alignment
items.summary: Technical decisions explained in the language of the business, and teams moving in the same direction.
deliver: Technical discovery: scope, risks, dependencies and assumptions
Proposals with alternatives, costs and documented trade-offs
Staged delivery plans with agreed priorities
Code review and quality guidelines for the team
approach: I translate business requirements into measurable scope and explicit risks
I present options with their impact instead of a single answer
I facilitate agreements between product, engineering and operations

process.title: How I work
process.subtitle: A short, transparent process that scales to the size of the challenge.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: I understand the context, constraints and what success means. I leave with scope, risks and assumptions in writing.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I propose an architecture with alternatives and trade-offs. We decide together and the decision is recorded.

steps.title: Incremental delivery
steps.text: I ship in stages, with tests and pipelines from the first one. Every release can be demonstrated and rolled back.

steps.title: Operation and handover
steps.text: I leave observability, documentation and practices your team can sustain without depending on me.
